# Your recipe says 85 stems. Your invoice says ten bunches. Which one are you marking up?

> Free calculator for wedding and event florists: price a proposal from the recipe up, buying whole bunches instead of loose stems, add a shrink allowance before the rounding, price labour by the hour, and see the gross margin — plus what a per-stem markup sheet would have under-quoted.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
